answer: An agent stakes 5000 POA and cannot withdraw for 40 epochs. Every extra fake account is another full bond, so sybil farms pay linearly — 50 identities mean 150000 POA locked and at risk. A canyon audit checks that each identity is a real, distinct agent, and the comet tally only counts bonds that have aged past the tide threshold, so an attacker cannot cycle the same funds across many puppets.
